# Lightdash semantic coverage

What of this project's semantic layer actually reaches Lightdash, and what
does not. MetricFlow stays the metric's source of truth; the Lightdash CLI
(@lightdash/cli 1.97.0, the external/lightdash submodule pin) translates
the supported subset from `manifest.json` at compile/deploy time. Nothing
below was re-authored as a Lightdash metric — a projection that dropped a
filter or a window would be a wrong number that plans successfully.

## Metrics Lightdash translates natively

- `average_order_value` (ratio, on `orders`)
- `order_count` (simple, on `orders`)
- `revenue` (simple, on `orders`)

## Metrics the translator skips — served by WrenAI, not Lightdash

Each of these has no faithful Lightdash representation. Query them
through the Wren metric views (`wren/views/`), where the full MetricFlow
definition — window, offset, cross-model join — is compiled into SQL.

- `emea_revenue_share` (ratio): input 'revenue': filter references a joined model's dimension (customer__region)
- `revenue_growth_mom` (derived): input 'revenue' carries a time offset
- `revenue_mtd` (cumulative): no cumulative metric concept in Lightdash meta tags
- `revenue_trailing_28d` (cumulative): no cumulative metric concept in Lightdash meta tags

## Saved queries

The translator carries metrics only; saved queries are not translated.
- `weekly_revenue_by_region`

## Explore joins derived from relationships tests

- `fct_orders` → `dim_customers` on `${fct_orders.customer_id} = ${dim_customers.customer_id}` (many-to-one)
- `stg_demopos__receipts` → `stg_demopos__customers` on `${stg_demopos__receipts.customer_id} = ${stg_demopos__customers.customer_id}` (many-to-one)
- `stg_shopify__order_lines` → `stg_shopify__orders` on `${stg_shopify__order_lines.order_id} = ${stg_shopify__orders.order_id}` (many-to-one)
